limitations: Scripted ordinary digital-input samples and staged fixtures are not human balance approval.
One Storm Loom six-level sample ends in a legitimate defeat after five clears; longer Storm samples also include defeats. No sampled stall is accepted.
SDL dummy presentation and virtual controllers do not establish physical display, controller or speaker quality.
The exhaustive matrix covers four gameplay channels for twenty fixed steps; it is a stability check rather than proof that every mix can clear.
Directional source grids, source-pixel conservation and actual small-size renders are checked; art quality still benefits from human review.
The isolated wheel uses existing Python/Pygame dependencies with host imports and external content from the extracted installation.
No named gameplay policy, API change, runtime generation or mandatory network dependency was added to the host.
